retrieved_note: Verified 2026-05-25 against HBL Islamic public product pages and the Jan-Jun 2026 Islamic Schedule of Bank Charges (ISOBC). Re-verified 2026-09-23 against the Jul-Dec 2026 ISOBC (Islamic_Schedule_of_Bank_Charges_for_July_to_December_2026_-_English.pdf, effective 1 Jul-31 Dec 2026; debit-card table p.16, footnotes p.17, Islamic Prestige Part T p.23-25, Islamic Premium Part U p.25, Islamic Preferred Part V p.26) and the live HBL Islamic debit-card and Islamic Prestige pages. No separate Jul-Dec 2026 Islamic Premium addendum is listed on the SOBC resources page. HBL Islamic does not publish a salary or minimum balance threshold for consumer Islamic debit cards — cards are issued to existing Islamic account holders and inherit any account eligibility from the linked Islamic account. The linked Islamic Current and PLS Saving accounts themselves carry no minimum balance, so the card-level balance field is intentionally null (not zero) for consumer tiers.
